data.title: Customer Success Manager - German Market (Berlin)
data.description:
At Lexroom, we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust. In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.

We're growing fast, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team committed to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the evolution of legal AI with the same rigor and precision that define our product.

Join us as Customer Success Manager to build Lexroom's German customer base from the ground up.

You will be the first dedicated CS hire for the German market, owning the full portfolio of German customers end to end. The product already won in Italy, with the numbers to prove it. Germany is next, and you own it.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own the full German customer portfolio from handover to renewal, with a clear goal: keep every customer (retention first) and grow each account through proactive upsell and uplift.

  • Run a proactive, commercial CS motion. You do not wait for customers to call. You call them, spot the opportunity in every conversation, and bring it home.

  • Be the single point of contact for German customers, from onboarding and product expertise to support requests, gathering feedback and feeding it back to Product and Marketing.

  • Adapt the Italian playbook to Germany, importing what works and localizing it for the German market.

  • Own your numbers: build dashboards, monitor KPIs, and report on the health and growth of your portfolio.

What we're looking for

  • 2 to 4 years in Customer Success or account management, ideally at a SaaS, tech, or software company. Exposure to legal or professional-services customers is a plus.

  • A commercial mindset. You see every customer touch as a chance to add value and expand the account. Direct sales experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • CRM fluency. Experience working a portfolio in a CRM; HubSpot is a plus.

  • Comfort building in a fast-moving market and staying hands-on, including operational support, while the market scales.

  • Languages: native-level German and fluent English are required.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

How we work

Lexroom is building the platform where legal work gets done. Founded in Milan in 2023, we are the legal AI built data-first for civil-law Europe: a proprietary base of 7M+ verified legal sources, used today by 12,000+ law firms and in-house legal teams. We recently closed a USD 50M Series B led by Left Lane Capital, with investors including Base10 Partners and Eurazeo, bringing total funding to over USD 73M, to expand across Europe starting with Spain and Germany.

We move fast and accurate, own outcomes, and say what we mean. Impact is defined by execution, not by title.

What Sets Us Apart

An Exceptional Team.

At Lexroom, you'll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI.

Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results.

You'll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth.

Growth that Matters.

We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead.

Your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field.

Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you're ready to take responsibility, you'll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects.

Rewarding Your Contribution.

We value excellence and share success:

  • Annual Salary Range: €65K – 75K€

  • Equity Package: Align your growth with the company's long-term success.

Benefits That Matter

  • Hybrid Work: Split your time between working from home and collaborating in our Berlin office three days a week, with flexibility.

  • Performance Bonuses: Rewards tied directly to measurable results.

  • Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas.

Hiring process and timeline

  • Intro call with our Talent team: motivations, fit, and the essentials

  • Interview with the Team Manager: your experience and potential for the role

  • Interview with the German Team: get to know each other and discuss upcoming challenges together

  • Last step:

    • Meet the Global Head of Customer Success to get to know each other and discuss Lexroom values

    • Practical exercise: a real customer scenario you prepare in advance, then a live call simulation with the Team Manager and the German Team

At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose.

We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation Range: €65.000- €75.000K

data.title: BDR Team Manager - German Market (Berlin)
data.description:
At Lexroom, we’re not just building software; we’re revolutionizing the way legal professionals work.

Our mission?

To empower lawyers, law firms and companies with a world-class AI product that saves time, boosts productivity, and redefine what’s possible in the legal world.

To become the most innovative AI company.

To build the new sales standard, the sales school for B2B sales.

We’re changing the game, and we’re doing it with a team of rockstars who are looking for their next big challenge and ambition.

 

Why Lexroom?

  • Shape the Future: Be part of the team that’s leading the AI revolution for legal professionals.

  • Grow with Rockstars: Collaborate with industry-leading talents in an environment that values creativity, ambition, and growth.

  • Make an Impact: Your work will directly influence how lawyers around the world practice law—more efficiently, effectively, and intelligently.

At Lexroom, we don’t just promise career growth; we promise a journey of learning, impact, and purpose. Ready to change the world of law?

 

Your key responsibilities

We’re building the outbound engine that will define how legal teams adopt AI at scale. As BDR Team Manager, you’ll lead and grow a team of BDRs focused on generating qualified pipeline for SMB, partnering tightly with AEs and Marketing to land new accounts, with a focus on the German market.

  • Own pipeline creation for your segment: targets for meetings held, SQLs, qualified pipeline €, coverage, and conversion rates.

  • Lead, coach, and develop BDRs: weekly 1:1s, call coaching, deal/account coaching, skill diagnostics, performance plans; raise the bar on quality, not just activity.

  • Build a repeatable outbound system: ICP refinement, messaging frameworks, multi-threading plays, account plans, sequencing (email/phone/LinkedIn), objection handling, and “next step” discipline.

  • Operational excellence: forecasting for pipeline generation, dashboarding, QA of CRM hygiene, and tight feedback loops with AEs on lead quality and disposition.

  • Hiring and onboarding: source/interview BDR talent; structured onboarding plan; ramp to productivity with clear milestones.

  • Cross-functional alignment: translate market feedback into product/marketing inputs; coordinate campaigns and account-based initiatives; create a clean handoff motion BDR → AE.

  • Experimentation and iteration: run A/B tests on messaging, segments, channels, sequences; scale what works, kill what doesn’t. Fast.

  • Set culture: high standards, low ego, high ownership; truth over vibes (clean reporting, no sandbagging, no “happy ears”).

 

What we’re looking for

  • Proven BDR leadership in B2B SaaS: built/coached teams that consistently hit pipeline targets (not “activity targets”).

  • SMB outbound competence: account-based prospecting, multi-stakeholder mapping, multi-threading, and value-based messaging.

  • Strong coaching craft: you can diagnose why performance is low (skill vs will vs territory vs messaging) and fix it with a plan.

  • Data-driven operator: comfortable with funnel metrics, conversion levers, experimentation design, and performance management.

  • Fluent in German (native or C1+) and English

Tool fluency: CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), sequencing, Sales Navigator; strong hygiene and reporting discipline.

 

What We Bring to the Table

An Elite Team of Rockstars.

At Lexroom.ai, you’ll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in tech and legal AI. Our small, entrepreneurial teams are driven by impact and autonomy, allowing you to contribute directly to revolutionising the legal industry. You’ll work side by side with pioneers who are as passionate about innovation as they are about personal and professional growth.

Unmatched Growth Opportunities.

We believe in hiring exceptional talent and empowering them to lead. As one of the first hires at Lexroom.ai, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the future of legal technology. Your contributions won’t just be noticed—they’ll be transformative. Here, age and title don’t define your impact; your vision, execution, and passion do. If you have the ambition and drive, you’ll rapidly advance and take on leadership roles in game-changing projects.

Competitive Pay and Equity.

We recognize talent and reward it. Expect competitive compensation with rapid growth tied to your impact. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Annual Salary Range: €120K – 130K€ [uncapped and accelerated variable]

  • Relevant stock option package: Your hard work will directly contribute to—and benefit from—our success.

 

Perks That Make a Difference

  • Hybrid Work Model: Split your time between working from home and collaborating in our dynamic Berlin Sales Hub, balancing flexibility and team connection.

  • Meal Vouchers: Receive ticket vouchers to make your lunch breaks more enjoyable.

  • Performance Bonuses: Be rewarded for your hard work with production bonuses tied to your impact and results.

  • Team Retreats & Building Activities: Experience periodic retreats and team-building activities that strengthen collaboration and fuel creativity.

 

At Lexroom, we’re driven by bold ambitions and a passion for excellence. We’re building something great, and that requires dedication, hard work, and a commitment to continuous growth. If you’re excited about the opportunity to challenge yourself, work hard and make a real impact, then we’d love to see your application.

Compensation: €120K – €130K • Offers Equity

data.title: Junior Production Engineer
data.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Junior Production Engineer, you'll be right at the heart of our production floor — supporting day-to-day operations, driving continuous improvement, and helping us scale safely and efficiently as we grow.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day hands-on support in the production area, including the inspection of non-conforming (NOK) robot modules

  • Independently run small-to-medium continuous improvement projects focused on enhancing production safety, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), and quality

  • Own, create, and maintain comprehensive work instructions for all internal assemblies, and support the creation of training documentation

  • Support the implementation of quality assurance processes and maintenance activities

  • Support the creation of FMEAs for all new robot modules and take ownership of executing the resulting risk-mitigation tasks

  • Support the team during production trials and cross-functional change management processes

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a similar field

  • First working experience (including internships or working student positions) in a (high-volume) production environment

  • A strong hands-on mentality with a proactive, self-starter approach to problem-solving

  • Highly adaptable and willing to support a wide variety of projects as the production area scales

  • Nice-to-have: initial experience with ERP systems, time analysis, or Lean Manufacturing concepts

  • Fluent in English and German

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

data.title: Senior Partner Manager - DACH
data.description:
About the Role

As our Senior Partner Manager DACH, you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow.

You will report to the VP Partnerships.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment.

  • Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth.

  • Partner Performance: Monitor partner health, pipeline and revenue performance, identify risks early, and hold partners accountable to agreed activities and results.

  • Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle.

  • Account & Whitespace Planning: Work side by side with strategic partners to analyse their customer base, identify whitespace opportunities and build plans to generate new business together.

  • Partner Acquisition: Identify, qualify and recruit high-potential new partners, particularly across the HR ecosystem, assessing them based on strategic fit and revenue potential.

  • Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships.

  • Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team.

What You Bring

  • Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships.

  • DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners.

  • SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment.

  • Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models.

  • Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.

  • Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions.

  • Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance.

  • Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities.

  • Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget

  • Pension scheme & wellness/fitness benefits

  • Country-specific holiday policies apply

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • Home office budget and allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at 

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.
